declarations.description:
A live "work in progress" line: an animated indicator, a label that shimmers, waves or fills while the work runs,
trailing dots and an optional elapsed-time counter, like an agent's "✻ Scheming… 12s". Give it several `messages`
and it rotates through them. When the work ends, set `state` to `done` or `error`: the animations stop, the
indicator turns into a check or a cross, and the line stays as a record.

The element is a polite live region (`role="status"`) that announces the label and state changes only, never the
rotating messages or the counter. With a `value` it becomes a progress bar whose label fills to that fraction.
Every animation stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
declarations.name: WorkingIndicator

cssProperties.description: Space between the indicator, the label and the meta text.
cssProperties.name: --c2-working-indicator--gap

cssProperties.description: Width and height of the indicator box.
cssProperties.name: --c2-working-indicator__indicator--size

cssProperties.description: Shimmer band, wave crest and filled part of the label.
cssProperties.name: --c2-working-indicator__label--highlight-color

cssProperties.description: One shimmer, wave, pulse or fill cycle.
cssProperties.name: --c2-working-indicator__label--animation-duration

cssProperties.description: Delay between two letters of the `wave` effect.
cssProperties.name: --c2-working-indicator__label--stagger

cssProperties.description: How long each of the `messages` stays on screen.
cssProperties.name: --c2-working-indicator__label--rotate-duration

cssProperties.description: One cycle of the trailing dots.
cssProperties.name: --c2-working-indicator__ellipsis--animation-duration

cssProperties.description: Colour of the elapsed time and the meta text.
cssProperties.name: --c2-working-indicator__meta--color

cssParts.description: Box around the built-in indicator, the indicator slot that replaces it, and the done-icon and error-icon slots.
cssParts.name: indicator

cssParts.description: Text container of the label: it wraps the label text, or the default slot content that replaces it.
cssParts.name: label

cssParts.description: Container placed after the label, wrapping the elapsed time and the meta slot.
cssParts.name: meta

slots.description: Label content, used instead of `label`/`messages`. The `wave` effect needs plain `label` text to split into letters.
Custom indicator replacing the built-in one while the work is running or paused.
slots.name: indicator

slots.description: Mark shown in the `done` state. Defaults to a check.
slots.name: done-icon

slots.description: Mark shown in the `error` state. Defaults to a cross.
slots.name: error-icon

slots.description: Supporting text after the label and the elapsed time, e.g. "esc to interrupt".
slots.name: meta

members.name: label
members.description: Text of the line. Defaults to "Working" when neither `messages` nor slotted content is given.

members.name: messages
members.description: Labels to rotate through while running, e.g. `["Scheming","Pondering"]`. Overrides `label` while running.

members.name: indicator
members.description: Animated mark before the label: `glyph`, `dots`, `ring`, `pulse`, `orbit` or `none`.

members.name: effect
members.description: How the label animates while running: `shimmer`, `wave`, `pulse`, `fill` or `none`.

members.name: doneLabel
members.description: Label shown in the `done` and `error` states, e.g. "Schemed for 14s". Defaults to the running label.

members.name: elapsed
members.description: Shows the time spent running after the label.

members.name: started
members.description: Start of the work as a millisecond timestamp, so a re-rendered line keeps counting from the real start.

members.name: value
members.description: Progress between `0` and `max`. Makes the line a progress bar; the `fill` effect then fills to this fraction.

members.name: max
members.description: Value that fills the whole label.

members.name: startedAt
members.description: Timestamp the counter measures from; moved forward on resume so paused time is not counted.
